messages:
maria: Quick sync — customers keep asking for a 'KPI-linked error digest' in Console. Proposal: small-scope MVP (6 weeks) that includes a single dashboard, a daily digest email, and an alert that ties error spikes to cost anomalies + top traces. Need scope decision on tracing hooks depth for v1. Opinions?
aj: I like a minimal approach: dashboard + alerting linking error counts -> per-model cost growth. Hold off on full-span reconstruction. Add route+model tags to traces and surface top 5 traces.
leila: From customer side: they want attribution by tenant and route, and a basic "root cause hint" (error class grouping + top stack frames). Can we include that without heavy storage?
derek: Feasible. Runtime can emit route/model tags quickly. Tracing hooks: lightweight span annotations (route, model_id, batch_size, quant_profile). Sampling plan: 1% baseline, auto bump to 10% on detected error/cost spike. Keep retention short (7d) for launch. Perf impact should be <1% if we do annotations only.
maria: Draft acceptance criteria (MVP):
  1) Console dashboard showing top errors by route and delta in cost (24h vs 6h baseline)
  2) Alert rule: error_rate > 3x baseline AND cost_delta > 5% over 15m -> creates ticket with links to traces/logs
  3) Daily digest emailed to SRE/product owners with top 10 problematic routes + one-line root-cause hint
  4) Per-tenant filter supported in dashboard and alerts
aj: Add fallback behavior: when traces unavailable, link to recent request table + logs snippet. Canary plan: enable for 10% of tenants for 48h.
leila: Customer asks to prioritize: per-tenant CSV export and a "why" card that shows recent deploys impacting the route. Does runtime surface deploy-tag?
derek: Yes, deploy-tag is available. Will add to span annotations. High-level work items and rough estimates: (A) tracing hook PR (3w), (B) telemetry schema update & ingestion (1w), (C) dashboard + alert template (1w), (D) digest/email worker + UX (1w). Total ~6w but parallelize (A+B) and (C+D).
maria: Tradeoffs for MVP: no full-span capture, no long-term storage, limited sampling. Customers get quick visibility and root hints, not deep forensic flows. Sound ok?
aj: :thumbsup: Sounds reasonable. Need a quick UX mock for the email digest + dashboard widgets. @sophia can you do a 1-pager?
sophia: Yep — I'll put together an email mock + dashboard wireframe and drop it by EOD tomorrow.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary feature flag 'kpi_error_digest' created. Remember to include rollout plan in RFC.
maria: Next steps: I'll update the roadmap board, file an RFC with the ACs and rollout plan, and schedule a short review Friday 10:00am. If no objections, I'll mark MVP and kick tickets.
aj: Agreed — thanks.
leila: Thanks all, will collate customer ask list into the RFC.
derek: I'll start a PR draft for the hook and post a design doc link in the RFC.
maria: Great — closing for now.
